name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
steps: Soften the sliced onion and pepper in olive oil for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, season and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until the whites set.
Serve straight from the pan with bread.
